face.name: 腐蚀吐息
face.text: 对一个随从造成 3点伤害。如果你的手牌中有龙牌，还会命中敌方英雄。

face.name: Corrosive Breath
face.text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. If you're holding a Dragon, it also hits the enemy hero.
face.flavorText: It's a breath of fresh terror!

face.name: 眼镜蛇射击
face.text: 对一个随从和敌方英雄造成 3点伤害。
face.flavorText: 戴眼镜的蛇当然会瞄的更准一点。

face.name: Cobra Shot
face.text: Deal 3 damage to a minion and the enemy hero.
face.flavorText: "Cobra Shot" hurts way, way, way more than "Cobra Cuddle."

face.name: 剧毒箭矢
face.text: 对一个随从造成 2点伤害，如果它依然存活，则使其获得剧毒。
face.flavorText: 熬过痛苦，你就会更狠毒。

face.name: Toxic Arrow
face.text: Deal 2 damage to a minion. If it survives, give it Poisonous.
face.flavorText: What doesn't kill you makes you toxic.

face.name: 小型法术翡翠
face.text: 召唤两只3/3的狼。（使用一个奥秘后升级。）
face.flavorText: “牛头人得到了这块绿色的石头，想要用它的力量拯救自己的土地。他们释放了心中的怒火，族群却从此失落。究竟谁是猎手，谁又是野兽？”——《魔石》

face.name: Lesser Emerald Spellstone
face.text: Summon two 3/3 Wolves. (Play a Secret to upgrade.)
face.flavorText: An emerald stone for Tauren hands Who sought its strength to save their lands Their tribes now lost, their rage released Who’s hunting now? And who’s the beast?

face.name: 寄生感染
face.text: 使你的所有随从获得 “亡语：随机将一张野兽牌置入你的手牌”。
face.flavorText: 作为寄生虫最有趣的一刻就是破肚而出时吓宿主一跳……好吧，他们已经是死人了。

face.name: Infest
face.text: Give your minions "Deathrattle: Add a random Beast to your hand."
face.flavorText: The best part is the look on their face when you jump out of the cake! Err… corpse.

face.name: 眼镜蛇射击
face.text: 对一个随从和敌方英雄造成 3点伤害。
face.flavorText: 戴眼镜的蛇当然会瞄的更准一点。

face.name: Cobra Shot
face.text: Deal 3 damage to a minion and the enemy hero.
face.flavorText: "Cobra Shot" hurts way, way, way more than "Cobra Cuddle."

face.name: 法术翡翠
face.text: 召唤三只3/3的狼。（使用一个奥秘后升级。）

face.name: Emerald Spellstone
face.text: Summon three 3/3 Wolves. (Play a Secret to upgrade.)

face.name: 先知者沃
face.text: 扰魔。在你施放一个法术后，&发现一张来自过去的自然法术牌。
face.flavorText: 她冥想了两个星期，心无旁骛地探知着宇宙的每一个角落，事无巨细，无所不包。当她从冥想中醒来，口中只吐出了一个声音：“喔。”

face.name: Farseer Wo
face.text: Elusive After you cast a spell,& Discover a Nature spell from the past.
face.flavorText: For two weeks, she meditated in silence, undisturbed as she peered into the endless, unfolding facets of the universe. No pathway lay unexplored, no stone left unturned. When she finally snapped from her fugue, she uttered a single word: "Woah."

policies.damage: Cobra faces remain distinct IDs; original target plus enemy hero are one ordinary DamageBatch; Breath checks current held Dragon tribes at payload evaluation.
policies.poison: Original nonredirected minion must survive the ordinary health result; grant uses its captured face/controller/residence and ordinary keyword lifecycle.
policies.emerald: Only original committed friendly hand Secret spells advance the held physical stage once per event, including countered submissions; automatic casts and secret installation are not plays. Reuse original clear_local hand-upgrade policy.
policies.wolves: Two/three/four ordinary attributed named Wolf summons; capacity, death checkpoints, quantities and cast cause remain public.
policies.infest: Capture active living ordinary friendly minions once; permanent original captured grants stack and are silence/removal aware. Actual death controller uses the ordinary complete host Beast generation query.

uncertainties: No complete Hunter Nature source binding until Revive Pet, Wild Spirits and Shellshot and their necessary effects close.
Exact CN health redirection/survival-grant, midgrant transformed/controlled targets and Spellstone cost/reset/counter windows retain explicit existing local policies.
No formal pool, version/hotfix or CN edge calibration claim.
